Title: Oracle Database Enterprise Edition price reduced

Body.Content:
Deploying Oracle databases in Azure can be more cost effective. With subscription billing cycles starting on or after May 1, 2015, the price for Windows-based virtual machines that include licensing for Oracle Database Enterprise Edition will be reduced by 15%–20%. Learn how Azure can help you quickly deploy Oracle Database instances for development, testing, or production by visiting the Try Oracle Software on Microsoft Azure webpage. Price reductions affect the following virtual machine images:
  • Oracle Database 11g R2 Enterprise Edition
  • Oracle Database 11g R2 and WebLogic Server 11g Enterprise Edition
  • Oracle Database 12c Enterprise Edition
  • Oracle Database 12c and WebLogic Server 12c Enterprise Edition
For more information, please visit the Virtual Machines page. For pricing information, please visit the Virtual Machines Pricing page.
